inventory_scope.note: Counts are aggregate and do not expose source identity or raw values.

collections.validated_boundary: station-side pressure, cascade and recharge behavior
collections.missing_boundary: synchronized vehicle/receptacle pressure, temperature, delivered mass or SOC

collections.evidence_class: locally cached public hydrogen validation material

open_tank_or_refueling_experiments.channel_scope: time, pressure, temperature and flow or mass-like signals

public_station_or_hose_reference.channel_scope: partial station/hose or tank boundary; controller and vehicle-loop fields are incomplete

dispenser_endpoint_tables.channel_scope: endpoint summaries without a synchronized time-base trace

release_fire_dispersion_and_detector.channel_scope: consequence, ignition, dispersion, detector and ventilation components

collections.validated_boundary: component-level tank, release, ignition, dispersion, detector and operational checks
collections.missing_boundary: a single independently scorable H70 station-to-vehicle synchronized cohort

collections.evidence_class: adjacent upstream or site-utility operational data
collections.validated_boundary: upstream hydrogen, utility demand, differential pressure and equipment-state plausibility
collections.missing_boundary: synchronized dispenser, hose and vehicle/receptacle event

coverage_assessment.main_limit: The local corpus is rich but heterogeneous: station-side telemetry, tank/refueling experiments and consequence experiments are not one synchronized H70 station-to-vehicle trace.

next_use: Use the controlled station bundle for pressure-cycle, cascade, recharge and station-state calibration behind an explicit opt-in profile.
Use public tank/refueling experiments for component thermal and pressure validation without claiming station-controller validation.
Use public release/fire/dispersion/detector data for consequence-component holdouts and safety-logic checks.
Keep the full-loop gate closed until an independently attested synchronized vehicle/receptacle pressure, temperature and delivered-mass or SOC trace is available.
claim_boundary: Local data are abundant for station-side and component validation, but they do not yet constitute a complete independently scorable station-to-vehicle validation cohort.
